say:2:1120827001:1.text: Wait... But you gave the butler snake venom. If you'd given him the spider venom, where would you look for the neutralizer?
say:2:1120827001:1.source_cn: 等等……但，你之前给执事的是蛇毒！如果给执事的是蜘蛛毒...

say:3:1120827002:1.text: Calm your little heart, furry one! Snake and spider venom pretty much work the same way, so the remedy should be the same.
say:3:1120827002:1.source_cn: 不用担心，仓鼠小妹！蛇毒和蜘蛛毒起效的那个什么……反正...

say:4:1120827003:1.text: It's just that the spider venom is much stronger, so you have to increase the dosage and add some alkaline water or something to reduce the toxicity. Or something like that... Anyway, it's guaranteed to work!
say:4:1120827003:1.source_cn: 不过就是蜘蛛毒更烈，所以得加大剂量，还得再添上些碱水之...

say:6:1120827004:1.text: Well, I'm not so tough, and I don't carry a gun, so to make a living in Alkali, I've gotta use my brains.
say:6:1120827004:1.source_cn: 我啊，没什么本事，也买不起枪，想在咸水镇讨生活，不就只...

say:7:1120827005:1.text: Spider venom, scorpion venom, snake venom... They're all handy tools, so I'm familiar with them.
say:7:1120827005:1.source_cn: 蜘蛛毒、蝎毒、蛇毒……这些有用的好东西，我多少都知道点。
